lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data for October 2015 medium-term projections were compiled into spatial datasets representing food insecurity classifications across Sierra Leone.
